name: vesta
description: Observe native session context and optionally submit bounded idle pings

warm.title: Experimental idle warming
warm.description: Submit idle pings only for fresh input above 100,000 tokens; savings are unproven

idle_ms.title: Idle interval (milliseconds)
idle_ms.description: Time between real activity or a completed response and an eligible ping

budget_ms.title: User inactivity budget (milliseconds)
budget_ms.description: Maximum time since real user activity before warming expires

paused.title: Pause all Claude warming
paused.description: Persistent pause, independent of warm opt-in

threshold.title: Input token threshold
threshold.description: Input must be strictly greater than this nonnegative integer

message.title: Keepalive body
message.description: Exact single-line text; install the matching K-only reply rule

control_changed_at.title: Control change time
control_changed_at.description: Control metadata only; never user activity
